"""Empirical: does ThreadPoolExecutor propagate ContextVars?"""
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from contextvars import ContextVar

V = ContextVar("probe", default="")
pool = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1)
V.set("parent-value")
fut = pool.submit(lambda: V.get())
print("propagated:", fut.result())
# sequential reuse on same worker thread
V.set("second")
fut2 = pool.submit(lambda: V.get())
print("second:", fut2.result())
pool.shutdown()
EOF
MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL="*" wsl.exe bash artifacts/validation-context-r18/run.sh /home/zeal/venv313/bin/python artifacts/validation-context-r18/probe_ctx.py 2>&1 | tail -3
